subject: Onboarding: EU OSS registration & PO fields for digital services vendor
messages:
From: Streamline Apps Ltd <legal@streamlineapps.com>

Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Vendor onboarding — VAT details for EU digital sales

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the quick reply over LinkedIn — I'm Marta from Streamline Apps' legal team. We're preparing to onboard with Redwood so your engineering team can consume our analytics SDK. A few VAT/tax questions before we complete the portal:

- We are incorporated in Poland (KRS: 0000123456) and currently registered for VAT in Poland (NIP: PL1234567890). We sell digital subscriptions to EU customers and intend to use the OSS scheme for cross-border B2C sales.
- For B2B customers (companies with a valid VAT number), our preferred flow today is to issue invoices without charging VAT (reverse charge).

Can you confirm what Redwood requires from vendors for: 1) PO creation (required invoice fields), 2) whether OSS registration affects how Redwood needs to receive invoices, and 3) if we should provide a VAT certificate or any other document for vendor setup?

We're ready to attach a sample invoice and our VAT certificate if that helps.

Thanks,
Marta Kowalska
Legal Ops | Streamline Apps Ltd
legal@streamlineapps.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 12:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — VAT details for EU digital sales

Hi Marta — welcome, and thanks for the clear summary. Looping in Laura (Finance) and Ben (Procurement) so they can confirm PO and invoicing requirements.

High level: Redwood supports both OSS and reverse-charge vendor flows, but the required PO/invoice fields differ slightly. To move forward please:

1) Upload your standard vendor onboarding form (we can accept the Excel you use) and the VAT certificate.
2) Send a sample invoice showing how you will bill Redwood (currency, line-item structure, VAT lines, and any OSS identifier if used).
3) Confirm your preferred billing entity (legal name and address to appear on the PO) and banking details for the payment stub.

Quick clarifications for Finance/Procurement:
- If Streamline uses OSS for B2C, Redwood treats OSS invoices as vendor-reported VAT; we will validate the OSS identifier and payment net/gross accordingly.
- For B2B reverse-charge invoices, Redwood expects the vendor to leave VAT at 0% and include the buyer VAT ID and a reverse-charge reference on the invoice.

Ben/Laura — can you confirm the PO metadata we need so Streamline can supply it on their invoices? Also flag any evidence or acceptance checks before we create a vendor record.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Head of Partnerships (EMEA) | Redwood Inference

Thanks — attaching the requested docs. A couple of details/questions inline:

Questions:
- OSS identifier: We plan to register OSS in Q4 and can include the OSS number on invoices going forward. For the initial months (before OSS is active) we will invoice with local Polish VAT charged for B2C and apply reverse-charge for EU B2B customers. Will Redwood accept initial invoices that show local VAT (for B2C scope) if we later provide OSS reconciliation reports?
- PO reference: We need to know which field Redwood will put on the PO so we can mirror it on invoices (PO number / Redwood billing entity / cost center).

Sample invoice notes: shows a single monthly subscription line, currency EUR, and the reverse-charge reference for B2B customers ("VAT reverse-charge, article 194(1)" as an example).

Appreciate confirmation so we can complete the portal setup.

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Streamline Apps Ltd <legal@streamlineapps.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding — VAT details for EU digital sales

Hi Marta — thanks for the docs, they look good. Summary and next steps from Finance/Procurement: 

1) PO / invoice fields Redwood requires (please include these exactly on invoices):
   - Redwood PO Number (we will provide after vendor record is created)
   - Redwood Billing Entity: Redwood Inference Ltd (EMEA)
   - Redwood VAT ID (we'll populate on the PO for reverse-charge evidence)
   - Vendor legal name and vendor VAT number (as on your certificate)
   - Invoice currency (EUR accepted for EMEA vendors)
   - Line-item description and net amount per line; VAT line if charged, or a 0% VAT line with a clear reverse-charge statement for B2B.
   - Bank details + IBAN and SWIFT for payment reconciliation.

2) OSS vs Reverse-charge:
   - OSS: If you move to OSS, include the OSS registration number and an OSS reference on invoices. Redwood will not apply reverse-charge for B2C invoices where OSS VAT is reported by you; Finance will validate OSS numbers against vendor portal evidence and monthly OSS reconciliation reports.
   - Reverse-charge (B2B): For B2B sales Redwood will accept 0% VAT invoices where the buyer VAT ID is provided and the invoice includes a reverse-charge reference.

3) Evidence required for vendor setup: vendor-onboarding-form.xlsx (received), VAT certificate (received). If you register OSS, upload the OSS confirmation once available. We may request a sample monthly OSS reconciliation file later for QA.

4) Timing & PO creation: Procurement (Ben) will create the vendor record and issue the first PO within 2 business days after we confirm bank details and the completed onboarding form. Please ensure the company address on the onboarding form matches the VAT certificate.

Ben — please proceed to create the vendor profile in Coupa and send the PO to the "billing@streamlineapps.com" address. Karthik, flag any entity mapping if this needs non-standard tax handling.

Thanks — and welcome aboard.

Laura Bennett
Director, Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
